points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable e55282a CMake build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench with explicit external/header-only roots, 2 CPUs,3GiB,256 processes. Initial missing header-root configuration failed; CTest has no tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses case/output and solver options; documented run_all orchestration, not every error path independently exercised.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, partition, physics, solver and IO modules are separated; fixed 2-D state limits extension.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Trust policy excludes external authorship search; no solver wrapper observed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp and case_config.cpp load case mesh and boundary settings; no two-mesh filename-only solver branch.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS and neighbor state exchange present; partition interfaces use only owned-side gradient and separately evaluated fluxes need not cancel.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Floors and trust-region updates exist; solver.cpp:1015–1019 declares convergence unconditionally at max steps, and residual target alone stops M2 laminar while force is changing.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Explicit validator and rank studies delivered; no CTests registered, and structural validation misses M2 laminar drift and partition-flux defect.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source/report modular and immutable snapshot includes report figures; raw result histories remain workspace evidence.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
